title: Eval cases for grill follow-ups
body:
### Summary

As the AI native engineer, I want eval cases with vague answers, so that a skill change that drops follow-ups fails tier 1.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: tier 1 over evals/cases/grill with a vague-answer case; expected: the case passes only when the recorded run asked a follow-up

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 1 criteria

### Scenario

Run `go run ./internal/evals/cmd/eval -tier 1` on the grill cases.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

### Links

depends-on #41
